name: Frost-silvered winter fall 021
modifier: strands drifting apart toward one side
prompt: a SPARSE OPEN NETWORK of thin vine runners spreading every way, branching and rejoining like a loose graph, small leaf clusters at irregular intervals, MOSTLY EMPTY SPACE — no main stem, no trunk, no origin, no line across the top, nothing it hangs from; thins out into a few isolated tendrils toward every edge so copies overlap freely; no rock, no cliff, no wall, nothing behind it, frost-silvered winter fall, strands drifting apart toward one side, towering, many times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

LIT_2.glow_concept: glowworm colonies strung in the foliage

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the small green points of light move, blinking slowly one after another. Everything else is frozen and pixel-for-pixel identical in every frame. Do not redraw anything else, and do not add or remove anything.
